CustomField.description: Numeric display order of this section within its Form Template Page (ascending). Drives the section sequence on the page; combined with the page's Position into the SortPosition formula. Defaults to 0. Use increments (10, 20, 30) to leave room for insertions.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The order this section appears within its page, sorted lowest to highest. Use spaced numbers like 10, 20, 30 so you can insert sections later without renumbering.
CustomField.label: Position
